name: Chromatic Dragonborn

traits.name: Chromatic Warding
traits.description: At character level 5, as an Action, become immune to the damage type of your selected Chromatic Dragonborn ancestry for 1 minute. You can do so once per Long Rest. While active, replace your existing ancestry resistance to that damage type with 100 percent resistance; do not add 100 percent to the existing 50 percent. This does not independently grant immunity to conditions associated with that damage type.

reviewNotes: The parent is not selectable: select one of Black, Blue, Green, Red or White Dragonborn leaves.
Breath Weapon activation, uses, damage and Dexterity saving throw are inherited from species.dragonborn.
No 5.5e universal Dragonborn flight or flexible breath shape is granted.
